ng-add.description: Adds an Angular Native app to this workspace, with its dependencies installed.

application.description: An Angular Native app: an Expo project in the workspace, registered in angular.json.

component.description: A component for an Angular Native app, with native elements and a test that runs in Node.

desktop.description: Adds macOS to an Angular Native app: @ng-native/desktop, macos in expo.platforms with Expo's out-of-tree platforms flag, the config plugin, and macos and package targets.
